# Rick Steves Travel Forum

> > Community-driven travel forum where Rick Steves readers share accommodation reviews, transportation advice, and destination-specific recommendations across Europe.

This forum serves as a companion resource to Rick Steves' guidebooks, featuring real traveler experiences and peer-to-peer advice on European travel planning, from Eurail passes to hotel stays in cities like Vienna, Prague, Dubrovnik, and London.

## Key Topics

- Rick Steves
- European accommodation reviews
- Eurail pass advice
- Budget hotels
- Dubrovnik and Croatia travel
- Vienna and Austria lodging
- Prague accommodations
- Train station hotels
- Day trip recommendations
- Cruise travel planning
- Mobile vs paper rail passes
- Sunday itineraries
- Dining recommendations
- Old Town sightseeing

## Transportation & Rail Travel

- [Paper vs Mobile Eurail pass on iPhones?](https://community.ricksteves.com/travel-forum/transportation/paper-vs-mobile-eurail-pass-on-iphones): Comparison of Eurail mobile vs paper passes for iPhone users

- [Hotel Golden City Garni Prague](https://community.ricksteves.com/travel-forum/czech-reviews/hotel-golden-city-garni-prague): Prague Hotel Golden City Garni review near Main Station

## Destination-Specific Recommendations

- [Accommodation, dining and sightseeing recommendations](https://community.ricksteves.com/travel-forum/croatia-reviews/accommodation-dining-and-sightseeing-recommendations): Dubrovnik accommodation & day trip recommendations for cruise travelers
- [Sunday itinerary Advice](https://community.ricksteves.com/travel-forum/england/sunday-itinerary-advice): London Sunday itinerary help for Tower of London & South Bank visit
